public_roots.name: Math.B699.I11TerminalMono.coverCheck_empty_interval
public_roots.type:
∀ (lo hi : ℕ) (cs : List NatInterval) (h : hi < lo),
  coverCheck lo hi cs = true

public_roots.name: Math.B699.I11TerminalMono.coverCheck_append
public_roots.type:
∀ (prefix suffix : List NatInterval),
  ∀ lo hi : ℕ, coverCheck lo hi prefix = true →
      coverCheck lo hi (prefix ++ suffix) = true

public_roots.name: Math.B699.I11TerminalMono.coverCheck_of_isPrefix
public_roots.type:
∀ (lo hi : ℕ) (small large : List NatInterval)
    (hprefix : small.IsPrefix large) (hcheck : coverCheck lo hi small = true),
  coverCheck lo hi large = true

public_roots.name: Math.B699.I11TerminalMono.coverCheck_take
public_roots.type:
∀ (lo hi : ℕ) (cs : List NatInterval) (k : ℕ)
    (hcheck : coverCheck lo hi (cs.take k) = true),
  coverCheck lo hi cs = true

public_roots.name: Math.B699.I11TerminalMono.sublist_counterexample
public_roots.type:
([(1, 1)] : List NatInterval).Sublist [(2, 2), (1, 1)] ∧
    coverCheck 1 1 [(1, 1)] = true ∧
    coverCheck 1 1 [(2, 2), (1, 1)] = false

public_roots.name: Math.B699.I11TerminalMono.not_coverCheck_sublist_mono
public_roots.type:
¬ (∀ (lo hi : ℕ) (small large : List NatInterval), small.Sublist large →
      coverCheck lo hi small = true → coverCheck lo hi large = true)

public_roots.name: Math.B699.I11TerminalMono.rowCoverCheck_append
